title: MLEADERSTYLE vertical attachment direct-writer encoding

scope.operation: Represent the unset top/bottom attachment defaults without emitting undocumented enum values, preserve documented values, and refuse invalid direct-writer inputs.
scope.authority: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference documents groups 272/273 with wire values 9 and 10; ObjectARX TextAttachmentType defines 9 and 10 among the attachment enum values. The ODA MLEADERSTYLE schema maps groups 272/273 to bottom/top attachment.
scope.zero_policy: Inference from the local typed-model default (0) and Autodesk's documented 9/10 DXF wire values: treat 0 as unset, omit the group, and recover the typed default on read. This is a direct-writer encoding decision, not a claim of native rendering acceptance.
scope.claim_boundary: Direct DXF writer encoding, domain refusal, rollback and retry only; native vertical text layout remains open.

implementation: Accept 0 as the unset model default and omit groups 272/273 from direct DXF output.
Write values 9 and 10 exactly; refuse all other values before output.

evidence.input: Runtime-generated typed MLEADERSTYLE objects; no fixture files committed.
evidence.valid_output: Corrected retries emit exact group 272/273 values 9 and 10; correcting 65535 to the model default 0 omits the corresponding group.
evidence.refusal: Each invalid value refuses before publication; destination sentinel and caller model value remain unchanged.
evidence.retry: The same dx_iface retries each invalid value and writes the exact valid field or omitted default.
evidence.matrix: Two fields × three invalid values × two encodings; 12 destination-safe refusals and 12 successful retries, integrated with the other selected enum-domain cases.
evidence.readback_boundary: The selected direct-writer check scans exact output tags. The existing source-bound AC1027 adapter transaction receipt RPP-5lx separately proves typed readback for explicit 9→10 edits.

remaining: Native vertical text layout, cross-version output, and independent producer acceptance remain open.
